name: v1.3.0
body:
## [1.3.0] - 24.11.2026

### Added
- Add `is_crontab_user_sudo` parameter by @antoniorodr
- Add is_crontab_user_sudo parameter by @antoniorodr
- Add the new `is_crontab_user_sudo` where is needed by @antoniorodr
- Add a better description for the crontab user input field by @antoniorodr
- Add support for the SSH key path by @antoniorodr
- Add SSH key path support by @antoniorodr
- Add `_version.py` to gitignore by @antoniorodr

### Changed
- Bumps version to v1.3.0 by @antoniorodr
- Use is_crontab_user_sudo when writing by @antoniorodr
- Write is now using `is_crontab_user_sudo` by @antoniorodr
- Refactor(connect): `connect_to_ssh_server` writes `ssh_key_path` to the by @antoniorodr
- Create `is_user_sudo` and `ssh_key_path` helpers by @antoniorodr
- Refactor find cronjob function by @antoniorodr
- Update `get_version` by @antoniorodr
- Import `_version.py` from init by @antoniorodr
- Create hatch hook to update version by @antoniorodr

### Fixed
- Pass is_crontab_user_sudo where is necessary by @antoniorodr
- Use `is_crontab_user_sudo` when showing/refreshing cronjobs by @antoniorodr
- `write_remote_crontab` now uses `is_crontab_user_sudo` by @antoniorodr
- Refresh the CronTable after switching servers by @antoniorodr
- Fix duplicate connection by @antoniorodr
- Update test_get_version by @antoniorodr

### Removed
- Remove unused parameters by @antoniorodr
